name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students (NCT of Delhi)
name_hi: दिल्ली में एससी/एसटी/ओबीसी छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
department: Directorate of Higher Education, Department of Education, NCT of Delhi

soft_clauses.text: Applicant must not be receiving any other scholarship or fee assistance for the same course and the same academic year.
The course must be post-matric (Class XI and above) and the institution must be recognised by the appropriate State/Central authority.
Students with a study gap year, or who have discontinued and rejoined the same stage, are not eligible in the year of re-admission.
OBC applicants must additionally produce a Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued within the current financial year.

benefits.description: Reimbursement of the tuition fee actually charged by the institution for the academic year, subject to a ceiling.
benefits.eligibility_note: Released to the institution on production of the fee receipt; available to both hostellers and day scholars.

benefits.description: Monthly maintenance allowance credited directly to the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
benefits.eligibility_note: ₹1,000 per month, i.e. ₹12,000 per academic year, subject to continued enrolment and attendance.

benefits_summary: Up to ₹48,000 per year toward tuition fee (actuals, capped) plus ₹1,000 per month maintenance allowance (₹12,000/year) — up to ₹60,000 per academic year.
eligibility_text: Post-matric scholarship for SC, ST and OBC students studying in Class XI, XII, undergraduate, postgraduate or professional courses within the National Capital Territory of Delhi. Applicant must be a permanent resident of Delhi with a Delhi domicile certificate. Annual family household income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 for SC and ST candidates, and must not exceed ₹1,00,000 for OBC candidates, supported by an SDM or Tehsildar attested income certificate. The scholarship reimburses tuition fee actually paid to the institution up to ₹48,000 per academic year and pays a maintenance allowance of ₹1,000 per month by direct benefit transfer to an Aadhaar-seeded bank account. Application is submitted through the institution or the Delhi e-District portal within the notified academic-year window. Non-Creamy Layer certification is mandatory for OBC applicants.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.notes: Aadhaar must be seeded to the DBT bank account used for the maintenance allowance.

required_documents.name: Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC)
required_documents.issuance_authority: Sub-Divisional Magistrate / Tehsildar, Government of NCT of Delhi
required_documents.notes: Must be issued in the prescribed Delhi format; central-format certificates require re-validation.

required_documents.name: Domicile / Residence Certificate (Delhi)
required_documents.issuance_authority: Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Government of NCT of Delhi
required_documents.notes: Primary proof of the Delhi domicile gate; valid for the notified tenure.

required_documents.name: Income Certificate (SDM/Tehsildar/e-District attested)
required_documents.notes: Highest-friction document in this scheme; charged at 0.20 when absent. A self-declaration reduces the charge to 0.10 for provisional submission only.

required_documents.name: Self-Declaration Affidavit of Family Income
required_documents.notes: Tier 0 by design: zero friction, but only provisionally acceptable — the SDM certificate is still required before final sanction.

required_documents.name: Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (OBC)
required_documents.issuance_authority: Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Government of NCT of Delhi
required_documents.notes: Must be issued within the current financial year; applies only to OBC applicants.

required_documents.name: Previous Examination Marksheet
required_documents.notes: Proof of merit and continuity of study.

required_documents.name: Bank Passbook with Aadhaar Seeding (DBT)
required_documents.notes: First page must show account number, IFSC and the beneficiary name.

required_documents.name: Bonafide Student Certificate
required_documents.notes: Issued by the college/school, usually same-day.

required_documents.name: Fee Receipt or Admission Letter
required_documents.notes: Basis for the tuition-fee reimbursement claim.

intake_window.source_note: Institution-level submission window for Academic Year 2026-27 as notified by the Directorate of Higher Education, NCT of Delhi.
